bullets.text: Virgin Media O2 Expands 5G SA - Virgin Media O2 now covers over 500 UK sites with its 5G Standalone network.
Gigabit IQ Crowdfunding Push - UK ISP Gigabit IQ seeks £270,000 to enhance its full-fibre and safety services.
Nokia's AI Infrastructure Strategy - Nokia's sales rise as it focuses on network infrastructure and AI-driven demand.
Vodafone Partners with Skylo - Vodafone IoT collaborates with Skylo for satellite connectivity in IoT applications.
TalkTalk Explores Sale Options - TalkTalk is negotiating to sell its consumer ISP unit and wholesale platform.
NEC's Energy-Efficient 5G Module - NEC introduces a compact amplifier to reduce power consumption in 5G base stations.
